none.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
none.comment: Move @types/node to 24.19.2, the newest types for Node.js 24.

minor.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
minor.comment: JSON the engine writes is laid out as oxfmt and Prettier lay it out, for the new `printWidth` setting: short lists on one line, objects as they are written, and `package.json` as `JSON.stringify` writes it. A keyed append takes `order: { after, before }`. `match(value, cases)` branches on a render model or mode. Removing the last item of a one-line array no longer leaves a stray quote.

minor.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
minor.comment: `pairwiseAnswers` returns a greedy covering array, so catalog CI and smoke tests plan far fewer answer sets for the same pairwise coverage. `requestArgv` takes a `preset` and writes `init --preset <id>` plus what differs from it, and takes the `catalog` so it writes `--without` for a default add-on the request leaves out and a full id where a short name is ambiguous; decision choices in the JSON envelope use the catalog of the version they plan with. `init`'s folder is relative to `--cwd`. On Windows, installing a template package and fetching an earlier catalog version work: the command line no longer quotes `npm.cmd`, which made npm look for its own code in the cache folder.

minor.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
minor.comment: The init wizard asks for every environment variable the plan needs, optional ones included, and later commands ask only for required secrets that aren't set yet. `askSecrets` is now `askEnv`. Plans no longer list add-ons the project already has. Apply retries Windows file locks for longer, including when it releases its lock, so a held lock file no longer blocks the next command. A saved plan records the template package versions it was made with, and `init --plan` loads exactly those, so a newer release never runs before the plan is checked.

minor.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
minor.comment: Add template packages. Anyone can publish templates for a product's catalog as an npm package (`definePack`), and `init @scope/name` installs one by name. The lock records each package's version and integrity, `upgrade` moves packages to their newest compatible version, and `catalog check` checks a package before it's published.

minor.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
minor.comment: Add `seedBases: "stored"` to `defineSettings`. The lock keeps each seed's generated text, so `upgrade` merges your edits three-way even when the catalog version the project started from can't be fetched.

minor.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
minor.comment: First release: a plan-first scaffolding engine. Describe targets, templates, slots and add-ons in a catalog, and the engine plans, applies, adds to and upgrades projects without overwriting your edits. Build a product CLI with `createCli` from `@buildkitgg/scaffolder/cli`.
